title: Privacy notice
description: How Impact Sol. collects, uses, stores and protects information submitted through this website and its enquiry forms.
body: This working draft notice identifies Impact Sol. as responsible for the personal information collected through this website. We collect only the information a visitor chooses to submit through an enquiry form, together with limited technical information needed to deliver and protect the service. We use that information to receive, assess, route and respond to the enquiry, maintain correspondence, prevent abuse and meet applicable legal duties. Netlify hosts the website and stores form submissions, and Google provides the notification email service; processing may occur outside Bangladesh. Enquiry records are normally kept for up to 12 months after the last substantive contact, unless an active relationship, legal requirement, dispute or security matter requires longer retention. Visitors may ask to access, correct or delete their information, object to processing or withdraw consent through the published contact route. This notice is based on the Personal Data Protection Act, 2026 and still requires qualified legal review before it is marked approved.
